ThinkByte: Niharika Chavati, vinay kovvuri, Charan
Sruteeshkumar
Raviteja Bingi
Key Takeaways
The meeting focused on addressing issues related to the healthcare project, particularly concerning mobile responsiveness, navigation, and deadlines.
Main issues discussed were delayed project timelines, mobile responsiveness, inconsistent UI components, and broken navigation paths.
Follow-up actions include freezing requirements, implementing thorough testing, and ensuring clear communication among team members.
Decisions were made to address responsiveness by utilizing common components, streamline UI/UX design, and set a clear deadline of November 1 for project completion.
Action Items
Mentioned that the content would be on a scroll and expressed doubt about its appearance in mobile view.
Speaker 2
Provide the project with issues, which is not acceptable to anyone.
Connect with the team, go through each component, and provide feedback.
The tournament thing needs to be released by tomorrow for mobile responsiveness.
Niharika
Address and document issues related to the tournament application for mobile responsiveness and functionality.
Project Release
Major release scheduled Friday, focusing on health care, dementia care project. This release involves deploying new features, updates to improve services in dementia care sector.
Delays due to adding new screens based on feedback, leading to scope expansion. Team faced challenges managing increased workload.
Teams work on responsiveness, critical functionalities to meet deadlines. Focus on fixing broken navigation paths, ensuring seamless user experience across devices.
Navigational issues in mobile app, preventing users from accessing key functionalities like registration, login.
Team Performance and Assignments
Efforts made to meet November 1 deadline by freezing requirements, focusing critical issues. Niharika and Chanel coordinating with team to streamline tasks and prioritize urgent fixes.
Niharika and Chanel star developers, leading project management. They tasked delivering key project components, including mobile responsiveness, UI consistency.
Concerns about project delivery by November 1 due to pace of work. Need to manage time effectively, ensure all tasks completed within deadline.
Requirements and Scope Management
New screens, functionalities added, impacting timelines. These additions stemmed from client feedback, internal reviews, necessitating adjustments in project scope.
Project delays due to constant changes, scope creep. Teams struggled to keep up with new requirements, affecting delivery timelines.
Requirements frozen, focus shifted to finalizing, testing current features. Teams instructed to halt any new changes, concentrate on stabilizing existing functionalities.
Project Management and Deadlines
Lack of clear communication, structured deadlines causing delays. Miscommunication led to misunderstandings, affecting project progress.
Need for clear deadlines, structured project management ensure timely delivery. Emphasis on setting realistic deadlines, maintaining clear communication among team members.

Clear deadlines, responsibilities established for timely delivery. Project managers set specific deadlines, assigned responsibilities for each team member to streamline workflow, enhance accountability.
API Issues and Functionality
Errors to be fixed before project completion. Development team prioritizing resolving API issues to restore full functionality.
API integration errors affecting leaderboard, entry issues. Failures in API calls resulted in missing data, broken functionality.

Issues with API calls, particularly leaderboard, leading to functionality problems. API integration errors caused disruptions in key functionalities, affecting user access to features like leaderboards.
Testing and Issue Tracking
Incomplete testing leading to persistent issues, breaking functionalities. Previous testing was insufficient, resulting in unresolved bugs affecting user experience.
Importance of rigorous testing to prevent breaking functionalities. Emphasis on thorough testing to identify, fix issues before release.
Thorough testing planned before finalizing to prevent issues. Team will conduct comprehensive test cycles, ensure all features work as intended before deployment.
Mobile Responsiveness and UI/UX
Issues with mobile responsiveness, broken components impacting user experience. Users reported difficulties with navigation, misalignment of UI elements on different devices.
Common components for responsiveness will be used to address issues. Team decided to implement reusable UI components to maintain consistency across different screen sizes.
Misalignment, broken components, affecting user experience. UI elements not rendering correctly on smaller screens, leading to poor usability.
Navigation and User Experience
Highlighted importance of seamless navigation for user experience. Ensuring users can easily navigate through app without encountering dead ends, errors.
Users unable to navigate due to broken paths, affecting experience. Navigation issues led to user frustration, inability to access necessary features.
Focus on fixing navigation issues for better user experience. Addressing broken links, ensuring all navigation paths are functional and intuitive.

The current sheet being reviewed is different from the one they had examined 15 days ago.
The challenge is that fixing one issue leads to the breaking of another feature during testing.
Unable to register on the mobile version due to the absence of a call-to-action and a hamburger menu, despite multiple attempts to highlight the issue.
The issue is repeatedly marked as fixed on every page, but it remains unresolved.
The recurring issue with the tournament card has not been resolved since it was previously raised.
The mobile menu component was created but not integrated into the designated space.
Displeased with the unusual and improper menu interface.
The login function may not be working, suggesting users should log in from the home page.
The transition from one slide to another is still not smooth.
Difficulty encountered when logging out and immediately trying to log back in, requiring a refresh for successful login and OTP retrieval.
Experienced frustration when attempting to log in, only to be redirected back to the home page after 5 seconds.
Expressed concern about a spacing issue between the top navigation and the first hashtag.
The system repeatedly prompts for the gamer handle, even when it is already provided, especially in the mobile view.
The images need to be resized for better visibility and appearance on the platform.
The API is not being called from the inspect.
The API is not being called for both logged in and logged out users.
The presence of the refresh token implementation is uncertain after clicking on it.
The addition of the gamer Huddl feature is not functioning as expected, leading to a lack of progress and a missed opportunity for presentation.
